data.long_meaning: In Greek origin, Bein means 'Foundation' or 'Established'. It is a name of strength and stability, symbolizing the foundation of faith, family, or a new beginning. In the Bible, Bein is not directly mentioned, but it can be found in various translations of 'Build upon this rock' in Matthew 7:24. The name Bein carries the meaning “Foundation, Established, Build” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bein usually hope their child will grow to embody foundation, established, build and live with faith, good character and purpose.
